# neon_org_spending_limit (Resource)

Manages an organization's monthly spending alert limit in cents.

```terraform
variable "neon_org_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "neon_org_spending_limit" "this" {
  org_id               = var.neon_org_id
  spending_limit_cents = 10000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) The Neon organization ID.
- `spending_limit_cents` (Number) Monthly spending alert limit in cents. The limit does not suspend computes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization ID used as the resource identity.

## Import

Import using the [import block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import):

For example:

```hcl
import {
  to = neon_org_spending_limit.this
  id = "org-foo-bar-123"
}
```

Import using the command `terraform import`:

```commandline
terraform import neon_org_spending_limit.this "org-foo-bar-123"
```
